title: arenaria tetraquetra subsp. racemosa
intro: Arenaria tetraquetra subsp. racemosa, commonly known as Rock Jasmine or Alpine Candytuft, is a flowering plant species belonging to the primrose family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, which can help to soothe and calm the body. The therapeutic actions of Rock Jasmine include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Arenaria tetraquetra subsp. racemosa include alkaloids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
